marketing_description: The Kichler Niagara wall sconce features a modern square design in brushed nickel‑finished stainless steel with a clear glass lens, delivering 800 lumens at 2700 K from a single 9 W A19 LED bulb. It is dimmable, rated for 120 V at 0.15 A, and installed with a 6‑inch lead wire on a wall mount, meeting IP20 enclosure standards in a compact 13 in H × 5 in W × 6 in D package.
